description: Download the latest report a Feed API schedule generated (compressed or plain CSV, XML or JSON). Returned as an embedded resource carrying the content type and file name eBay sent; files above 25 MiB are refused. Schedules exist only for LMS_ORDER_REPORT, which requires sell.fulfillment.

scheduleId.description: Feed schedule ID, from ebay_create_feed_schedule or a list

name: ebay_get_feed_schedule_result_file
